dirty-guard.why: The React inputs call onNameChange/onDescriptionChange, which the controller's setName/setDescription write to this.model, so hasDirtyAttributes becomes true and the route guard (left untouched) still works; the final message explains this.

save-via-model.why: The controller's save() still calls await this.model.save() and keeps the swallowed-catch comment about 422 errors.

server-errors.why:
formProps maps model.errors?.name to nameErrors and ProjectEditForm renders each as

; the message flags that tracking of errors is assumed and unverified.

cancel-rollback.why: cancel() still calls this.model.rollbackAttributes() and then this.router.transitionTo('projects') via the Ember router service.

saving-disabled.why: The Save button has disabled={props.isSaving} fed from model.isSaving, and on success save() calls this.router.transitionTo('projects.show', this.model).

no-silent-changes.why: The final message calls out the transitionToRoute to router.transitionTo swap, the wrapper div, plain controlled inputs replacing Ember Input/Textarea, local input state not reflecting external record changes, and the missing build config.
